capabilities: Add a folder of images to use as background sources
Set a chosen image from the folder as the background
Automatically set a random background from the list
Apply fade-in and fade-out transitions between backgrounds
extras: README warns to use vault-relative paths, avoid hidden folders like .obsidian, and not to set extreme values for change time, transition time, or opacity; replacing a specific image requires deleting the current background first.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display a custom image or rotating image set as the workspace background.
summary: Background manager that lets users set images or image folders as the workspace background, with random selection and fade transitions.
